title: Pešková and Peška v Travel Service (Case C-315/15), 4 May 2017
source: Pešková and Peška v Travel Service (Case C-315/15), 4 May 2017
excerpt: a collision between an aircraft and a bird is classified under the concept of ‘extraordinary circumstances’ within the meaning of that provision.
summary: A bird strike is an extraordinary circumstance.
